title: What is the average time outdoors?
description: Time outdoors over three days is shared equally to find the average, and the average is turned into boxes on a strip. The video breaks Keeko's doubt that the total is the average.
teaching_notes: One idea: the average is the total shared equally among the days. Watch for students who give the total as the average.

source: Over 3 days you spend 1.5 hours, 2 hours and 1 hour outdoors
video_script.why: The child has coloured one day on a strip and now shares the time of several days equally to find an average day.
video_script.substitution: Add the times of the days, divide by the number of days, and double the average hours for the boxes.
video_script.anchor: three day cards showing the hours outdoors, and a strip of forty eight boxes
video_script.wrong_answer: the average is four and a half hours
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko adds the three days and gives the total as the average, forgetting to divide by the number of days.
video_script.payoff_line: the average is one and a half hours a day and that is three boxes on the strip

final_answer.value: 1.5 hours a day, which is 3 boxes on the strip
final_answer.spoken: the average is one and a half hours a day and that is three boxes on the strip

hold_back: one and a half hours a day
maths_rules: each hour is 2 boxes: 1.5 x 2 = 3 boxes
slip: the total of the days is not the average
video_script.design: One idea: add the days, share equally, then double for the boxes. The wrong idea is that the total is the average. The day cards and the strip stay on screen all video.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; three day cards reading 1.5 hours, 2 hours and 1 hour; an empty strip of 48 boxes

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears
marks.days: the three day cards slide in with the time outdoors on each
marks.strip: the strip of forty eight boxes appears below the cards
marks.ask: a bracket with a question mark joins the cards and the strip

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book.
<bookmark mark='days'/>Over three days you spend one and a half hours, two hours and one hour outdoors.
<bookmark mark='strip'/>You also colour your day on a strip, with two boxes for each hour.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>What is the average time outdoors, and how many boxes is it on the strip?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko appears at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: three unequal stacks levelled into three equal stacks; the words total divided by number of days

marks.level: three unequal stacks are levelled into three equal stacks
marks.equal: each equal stack is labelled the average
marks.rule: the words total divided by number of days appear

narration: <bookmark mark='level'/>An average shares the total equally among the days.
<bookmark mark='equal'/>If every day were the same, each day would show the average.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>To find it, add all the days, then divide by the number of days.

beats.on_screen: Given: 1.5 h, 2 h, 1 h outdoors over 3 days; 1 hour = 2 boxes

marks.given: the three times and the strip rule are written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the three days are one and a half hours, two hours and one hour.

beats.on_screen: To find: the average time outdoors, and its boxes on the strip

marks.find2: the boxes on the strip are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find1'/>We have to find the average time outdoors.
<bookmark mark='find2'/>We also find how many boxes it fills on the strip.

marks.add: the three day cards are added into one total of four and a half hours

narration: <bookmark mark='add'/>Step one, add the three days. One and a half plus two plus one is four and a half hours.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: average = total / number of days = 4.5 / 3

marks.share: the total is shared into three equal parts, one for each day
marks.div: the working four and a half divided by three is written

narration: <bookmark mark='share'/>Step two, share the total equally among the three days.
<bookmark mark='div'/>Divide four and a half by three.

marks.box: two boxes are drawn for each hour of the average
marks.mul: the working average times two is written

narration: <bookmark mark='box'/>Step three, each hour is two boxes.
<bookmark mark='mul'/>Multiply the average hours by two.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 1.5 hours a day, which is 3 boxes on the strip

marks.strip: three boxes are coloured on the strip

narration: <bookmark mark='avg'/>The average is one and a half hours a day and that is three boxes on the strip.
<bookmark mark='strip'/>Those three boxes are coloured on the strip.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the strip
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: the label average on the total of 4.5 hours struck out; the total shared into three equal parts

marks.doubt: the label average is put on the total of four and a half hours
marks.total: the label is struck out and the total is named as the total of three days
marks.share: the total is cut into three equal parts, one for each day

beats.removed: the label average is struck out
narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the average is four and a half hours, because the days add up to that.
<bookmark mark='total'/>But four and a half hours is the total for three days.
<bookmark mark='share'/>An average is the share of one day, so we divide the total by three.
